name: Onyx Heart
source:
Perpetually-starving and mentally ill transfem vampire Capra is here to suffer or rejoice at life, and it is you who guides her through this torturous existence, filled with anxiety, drugs, friendship, and cosmic horror.

[From [url=https://snekofspice.itch.io/onyx-heart]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
永远挨饿、患有精神疾病的变性吸血鬼卡普拉来这里是为了生活中的痛苦或欢乐，是你引导她度过这个充满焦虑、毒品、友谊和宇宙恐怖的折磨人的生活。

[来自[url=https://snekofspice.itch.io/onyx-heart]itch.io[/url]]
